question: Show the invoices from our two best months of 2025 by invoiced revenue in TZS.
reason: Both tables are right (2025-12 and 2025-03 selected; 202 invoices, 20 shown), but the answer text is only the table context ('Limited to the 2 months with the highest Invoiced revenue (TZS) / Showing 20 of 202'): it never names the two months.
